title: mut.channel_morakana_cumulus_satellite
mutation_directive: MORAKANA (Tiri Kananuruk + Sebastián Morales) — Cumulus — Cumulus — 2025 Lumen Prize Gold winner. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Live cloud cover over the Mexico-US border, sourced from NOAA satellites: soft fluffy white volumetric masses drifting against a dark earth-toned ground, with a faint border line invisible from above. Slow, atmospheric, geopolitical-melancholy. Volumetric clouds + thin terrain texture. TECHNICAL HOOKS for three.js / GLSL: Volumetric cloud rendering via raymarched 3D worley/perlin noise in a fragment shader (the standard three.js volumetric cloud recipe). Animate by translating the noise lookup along a wind vector. Underneath: a procedurally generated terrain plane with a faint contour line at a fixed (lat,lng). Optional: tint clouds based on time-of-day; add slight 'satellite scan' rolling shutter artifact. Palette: warm earth ground, cool grayscale clouds, single thin red contour. WHY DIVERSE: Pool has zero volumetric / atmospheric work — all surface or particle, never a fog/cloud. Also adds a politically-loaded geographic anchoring rather than abstract math. Stay faithful to the visual signature; pick whatever three.js primitives are needed (Lines2 / InstancedMesh / SphereGeometry / custom ShaderMaterial) — but the FORM should read as if this artist made it. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2025-winners
